The local\n// buffer holds only those rows, so mat has rowCount * N elements.\nvoid initMatrix(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N, const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowCount) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[i * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, rowBegin + i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// First row owned by rank r when N rows are split as evenly as possible across p ranks\nconstexpr size_t rowBegin(const int r, const int p, const size_t N) noexcept {\n    return r * (N / p) + std::min(static_cast<size_t>(r), N % p);\n}\n\n// Number of rows owned by rank r\nconstexpr size_t rowCount(const int r, const int p, const size_t N) noexcept {\n    return N / p + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < N % p ? 1 : 0);\n}\n\n// Local block multiply: C (rows x N) = A (rows x N) * B (N x N), all row-major.\n// For every C element the products are still accumulated in increasing k order,\n// exactly as in the sequential reference, so results are bit-identical for any\n// process count. The loop nest is i-k-j so the inner loop is contiguous and vectorizes.\nvoid matrixMultiplyRows(const double* A, const double* B, double* C, const size_t rows, const size_t N) {\n    std::fill(C, C + rows * N, 0.0);\n\n    for (size_t k0 = 0; k0 < N; k0 += kBlockK) {\n        const size_t k1 = std::min(k0 + kBlockK, N);\n        for (size_t j0 = 0; j0 < N; j0 += kBlockJ) {\n            const size_t j1 = std::min(j0 + kBlockJ, N);\n\n            // Four rows of C at a time so each loaded B row is reused four times\n            size_t i = 0;\n            for (; i + 4 <= rows; i += 4) {\n                double* c0 = C + (i + 0) * N;\n                double* c1 = C + (i + 1) * N;\n                double* c2 = C + (i + 2) * N;\n                double* c3 = C + (i + 3) * N;\n                const double* a0 = A + (i + 0) * N;\n                const double* a1 = A + (i + 1) * N;\n                const double* a2 = A + (i + 2) * N;\n                const double* a3 = A + (i + 3) * N;\n                for (size_t k = k0; j < j1; ++j) {\n                        const double bj = b[j];\n                        c0[j] += x0 * bj;\n                        c1[j] += x1 * bj;\n                        c2[j] += x2 * bj;\n                        c3[j] += x3 * bj;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Remaining rows\n            for (; i < rows; ++i) {\n                double* c = C + i * N;\n                const double* a = A + i * N;\n                for (size_t k = k0; k < k1; ++k) {\n                    const double x = a[k];\n                    const double* b = B + k * N;\n                    for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; ++j) {\n                        c[j] += x * b[j];\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: compute a single element and compare.\n// Takes the full result matrix C (N x N). A and B are regenerated from their\n// closed-form values, which is identical to the initialized matrices.\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    // Check a few random positions\n    constexpr size_t checkPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};\n\n    for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n        for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n            const size_t i = checkPoints[pi] % N;\n            const size_t j = checkPoints[pj] % N;\n\n            double expected = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k) * getPseudoRndValue(N, k, j);\n            }\n\n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n\n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Each rank owns a contiguous block of rows of A and of C. B is needed in full\n    // by every rank and is generated locally, so no input data is communicated.\n    const size_t myBegin = rowBegin(rank, size, N);\n    const size_t myRows = rowCount(rank, size, N);\n\n    std::vector<double> A(myRows * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C(myRows * N);\n\n    // Initialize matrices\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    }\n    initMatrix(A, N, myBegin, myRows);\n    initMatrix(B, N, 0, N);\n\n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    matrixMultiplyRows(A.data(), B.data(), C.data(), myRows, N);\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    // The slowest rank determines the elapsed time\n    long long localMs = duration.count();\n    long long maxMs = 0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localMs, &maxMs, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computation time: %lld ms\\n\", maxMs);\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS\n        double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / (maxMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    bool valid = true;\n    if (printResults || validate) {\n        // Gather the full result matrix on rank 0\n        std::vector<double> full;\n        std::vector<int> counts;\n        std::vector<int> displs;\n        if (root) {\n            full.resize(N * N);\n            counts.resize(size);\n            displs.resize(size);\n            for (int r = 0; No input data is communicated.\n- **Kernel:** the i-k-j loop with k/j cache blocking, and four C rows at a time. Each C element still accumulates over k in increasing order, so the sum does not depend on the rank count.\n- **Timing:** timed between a barrier and the compute step, and reported as the slowest rank's time in the same `ms` format.\n- **Output:** all printing is done by rank 0, and the output text is unchanged.\n- **`-r` / `-v`:** C is gathered to rank 0 only when one of these flags is set. Validation regenerates A and B from their closed form instead of reading stored matrices.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and link `MPI::MPI_CXX`. I also added `-ffp-contract=off`; the reason is below.\n\n**Correctness:**\n- The original's odd-N results depend on GCC's codegen. Its vectorized loop rounds products separately, but its final odd term is fused with FMA. No reordering of mine can reproduce that for every N.\n- With `-ffp-contract=off` the even-N outputs match the original bit-for-bit. Odd-N outputs differ in the last digits, so their `-r` hashes will differ from the old ones.\n- Results are identical across rank counts 1, 2, 3, 4, and 8 for N = 1 to 257, and every run passes `-v`.\n- Help and unknown-option paths behave as before.\n- I measured no cost from `-ffp-contract=off`.\n\n**Performance (N=2048, one node):**\n\n| Ranks | GFLOPS |\n|---|---|\n| Original | 0.17 |\n| 1 | 5.2 |\n| 2 | 10.3 |\n| 4 | 20.4 |\n| 8 | 38.9 |\n| 16 | 77.7 |\n\n**Limits:**\n- The `-r`/`-v` gather uses `int` counts, so it fails once N² exceeds about 2.1 billion elements (N > ~46k).\n- I did not commit anything."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":628,"cache_read_input_tokens":52977,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":628},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ff2e8346-a4c5-4478-b933-c7dc35b8df30","uuid":"4d0f1fed-8e10-42cc-8f55-00627abcc644","timestamp":"2026-10-13T10:28:35.138Z","request_id":"req_011Cfz5WsK2pXNTuKwx81N4T"}
